newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's 1996 oil products demand up 6.5 pct - govt.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's 1996 oil products demand up 6.5 pct - govt.

text.p: South Korea's oil products demand rose 6.5 percent to 721 million barrels last year from 677.2 million in 1995, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy said on Thursday.
This compares with a 9.0 percent growth in domestic consumption in 1995, a ministry statement said.
The statement said the growth dragged due mainly to slower consumption rise of kerosene, diesel and C-type fuel oil as a result of tougher environmental regulations.
Oil refiners produced 724.1 million barrels of petroleum products in 1996 against 643.4 million a year earlier.

Production increased with the operations of Hyundai Oil Refinery Co's new 200,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit (CDU), Yukong Ltd's 200,000 bpd unit and LG-Caltex Oil Corp's 220,000 bpd unit.
South Korea currently has a government-licenced refining capacity of 2.44 million bpd.
